equipment_type: Split / VRF indoor unit interface (single unit)
applies_to: Mitsubishi Electric air-to-air split and indoor units connected one per adapter through the CN105 connector.
summary: The MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M+) plugs into the CN105 connector of one Mitsubishi Electric indoor unit and serves it on BACnet MS/TP (RS-485) or BACnet IP. For air-to-air units it gives on/off, mode, setpoint, fan speed and vane commands with matching status objects, room temperature, the fault code, and an option to feed a BMS room temperature to the unit.
notes: Access is not printed per object; it follows the guide's property table (AV, BO and multistate outputs have a writable present value and priority array; inputs are read-only).
The adapter detects the connected unit type and only serves the matching object list (Air-To-Air, Air-To-Water or Lossnay).
Temperature objects read in °C or °F according to the Temperature Units multistate output.
The older MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M, BACnet MS/TP only) has the same objects 0-11 but not BO 12 / AV 13 (external temperature).

source.title: Procon MelcoBEMS MINI (A1M+) Installation Manual (manual 1.0.3, firmware 4.1.1)

integration.summary: Set DIP switch 7 to BACnet, give the adapter a node address or IP, then write on/off, mode, setpoint and fan speed and read the matching state objects, room temperature and fault code.
integration.enable: No separate enable; the Setup objects command the indoor unit directly.
integration.remote_sensors: Set External Temperature ON/OFF Setup (BO 12) to ON and write External Temperature Input (AV 13); the unit then uses that value instead of its own temperature.
setup: DIP switch 7 OFF selects BACnet (MS/TP and BACnet IP); ON selects Modbus RTU.
DIP switches 1-5 set the RS-485 node address 1-30 (all OFF = 1, all ON = set in software); it is the MS/TP station ID.
DIP switch 6 ON fixes RS-485 at 9600 baud, no parity; OFF uses the software baud rate (MS/TP up to 76800).
Default IP address 192.168.92.114; network settings are changed on the adapter's web page.
Device instance, Max Master and Max Info Frames are set through Modbus holding registers 272-275.
gotchas: Fan speed and vane positions available depend on the indoor unit model.
If one adapter serves a twin/triple/quad system, the fault code object should not be relied on; the guide recommends one adapter per indoor unit.
